title: Repeated pattern machine
statement: For a finite Boolean word $p$, define a deterministic Turing machine with three work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states formed from sweep controls, counter-loop controls indexed by the $|p|+1$ possible counter values, and additional sweep controls. The machine is the sequential composition that copies tape $0$ onto tape $2$, expands the pattern $p$ on tape $1$, clears tape $2$, and then runs a counter loop whose body is the sweep phase and whose counter-decrement phase begins in its running state.
caveat: The component machines and composition operation are not defined in the supplied statement, so the exact transition behavior of the composition is unavailable.
